Class SimulationUI

java.lang.Object
presentation.SimulationUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Runnable
public class SimulationUI extends Object implements Runnable, Serializable
User interface for managing the simulation of a railway system. Implements Runnable and Serializable to support concurrent execution and object persistence. This class provides a graphical interface for: - Controlling simulation execution (start, pause, resume, stop) - Displaying real-time simulation statistics - Showing financial results and budget updates - Logging simulation events and activities - Managing train operations and cargo movements - Handling industry operations and cargo generation The UI is built using JavaFX and provides interactive controls for users to monitor and control the simulation process.

      public SimulationUI(Map map, Scenario scenario)
      Creates a new SimulationUI instance with the specified map and scenario. Initializes the controller and sets up the UI for simulation management.
      Parameters:
      map - The map to simulate, containing stations, industries, and routes
      scenario - The scenario to simulate, containing simulation parameters and constraints
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if map or scenario is null

  • Method Details

    • run

      public void run()
      Implementation of the Runnable interface. Manages the simulation lifecycle including starting, pausing, resuming, and stopping. Provides a graphical interface for controlling the simulation. This method: - Initializes the JavaFX stage and scene - Loads the FXML interface - Sets up UI components and event handlers - Starts the simulation in a separate thread - Displays initial simulation information
      Specified by:
      run in interface Runnable
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if required components fail to initialize
      IOException - if there are issues loading the FXML file

    • updateSimulationStats

      public void updateSimulationStats(int currentYear, int totalEarnings)

      Parameters:

      totalEarnings - The total earnings for the current period

    • updateTrainLoading

      public void updateTrainLoading(String locomotiveModel, String cargoMode, String stationName, int availableCargo, int currentCargoLoad)

    • appendLog

      public void appendLog(String message)
      Appends a message to the log area. Ensures thread safety by using Platform.runLater. This method: - Adds the message to the log area - Scrolls to the bottom of the log - Handles null log area gracefully - Ensures thread safety for UI updates
      Parameters:
      message - The message to append to the log
